quote: The City Traffic Engineer shall determine upon what streets angle parking shall be permitted, and shall provide signage or other markings to indicate where such parking is permitted. Where angle parking is permitted, no person shall stand or park a vehicle unless the front of the vehicle is pointed toward the direction of lawful traffic movement.

activation.condition: Angle parking is permitted at the street and the subject stands or parks a vehicle there; City decision and signage or markings need independent source review

obligation.description: Vehicle front points toward lawful traffic movement while standing or parked where angle parking is permitted
obligation.source_clause: the front of the vehicle is pointed toward the direction of lawful traffic movement

timing.description: During standing or parking; no numeric angle tolerance in the quoted law

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source measured toward or against one-way lawful traffic direction

parameter_refs.name: one_way_road
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: one-way street candidate; original lawful direction source required
